name: Airport Terminal Plain Lightly Salted Rice Cakes
whyItWorks: Puffed white rice and sea salt. Ultra-light, dry, non-perishable, and exceptionally easy to digest. Provides gentle, non-bloating carbohydrate energy during flights.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy a roll at Hudson News or airport sundry shops to keep in your personal carry-on bag for hunger emergencies.
